Leave all five approved patches, drafts, manifests, bundles, bibliographies and derived matrices byte-identical.
Build a new P32 preview attempt with the declared temporary-copy transformation and the unchanged zero-overfull/zero-undefined/zero-missing-glyph/zero-fatal acceptance checks.

decision_rule: A short unqualified author confirmation after presentation of this request SHA authorizes only this exact preview-only recovery and continuation of the prior bounded task. It is not approval of manuscript changes or an integrity PASS.
explicitly_forbidden: Edit the approved working manuscript or patch.
Alter visible Chinese/English text, source counts, mathematics, scientific results, Route or initial systems.
Relax or disable the clean-build gate.
Overwrite failed attempt history or successful outputs.
Canonical promotion, README/status mutation, Git synchronization, Stage 5 or 6.
